newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Richard Pieris announces bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Richard Pieris announces bonus issue.

text.p: Sri Lanka blue chip Richard Pieris & Co Ltd announced a bonus issue of one new share for every six held on Wednesday, stock exchange officials said.
The company's share capital will rise to 14.8 million shares from 12.7 million.

Richard Pieris is a diversified holding company, with interests in manufacture and distribution of household, industrial and agricultural products, tyre retreading and plantation management. Its share price closed at 127 rupees on Tuesday.
